mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission matrix removes the (Role x OperationKind) allow set; the injected fact then forces an AuditOfficer to invoke LookupRecord, which LeastPrivilege and FR_011 must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.callerRole = AuditOfficer and op.kind = LookupRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the audit-entry wiring removes the link between Operations and AuditEntries; the injection forces a Permitted LookupRecord operation with no audit entry, which the audit-completeness assertions must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupRecord and op.outcome = Permitted and no ae: AuditEntry | ae.ofOperation = op }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the snapshot=caller.role linkage allows AuditEntries whose recorded role differs from the actual caller's role, which AttributionCorrectness and AppendOnly are designed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.recordedRole != ae.ofOperation.caller.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: With universe witnesses removed, the injection still forces a concrete Permitted LookupRecord operation where the caller is NOT on the patient's care team — this is exactly the care-team gating violation that FR_006 and OwnershipBasedAccess must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamBypass { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupRecord and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = op.caller and m.subject = op.target and m.active = True) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing wiring lets the injection construct a non-care-team Permitted lookup, which leaks patient existence to non-care-team callers and breaks byte-equivalence guarantees.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = LookupRecord and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = op.caller and m.subject = op.target and m.active = True) }
